invariants.description: calibration_id is deterministic: SHA-256 of canonical JSON {impact_id, actual_class, phase}. No timestamp or random component. Same input always yields same ID.
invariants.exception: None — structural; duplicate detection implicit via ledger sequence

invariants.description: HMAC-SHA-256 chain links each CalibrationRecord to prev_digest. Any tampered record causes MCEChainError (fail-closed). Chain root is 64-zero hex string.
Any single-key weight shift exceeding HUMAN0_SHIFT_GATE (0.10) raises MCEHuman0Gate before any ledger or weight write. No write proceeds without human signoff for large calibration shifts.
submitted_by must be in VALID_SOURCES frozenset {cel_loop, governance_review, test_harness, phase163_migration}. Unlisted sources raise MCESourceError before processing.
Per-key weight delta is clamped to MAX_DRIFT (0.05). No single calibration event can shift any weight by more than 5%. Drift clamping is applied before weight persistence.
invariants.exception: MCEDriftError(RuntimeError) — raised if clamp logic is bypassed
